name: Houkago Gekisha Club ~In'yoku no Motif~
original_name: 放課後激写倶楽部～淫欲のモチーフ～
source:
Shame is art! Girls humiliation can reach the masterpiece level! This is the motto of main character who heads school photo club. All the five girls in club lead an active sex life with the boys of the same club, so protagonist has no difficulty inviting girls to a private shooting session for a solo exhibition.
